text:
Maria G.: Heads-up — NexaSupply just pushed the EU H100 shipment by ~10 days due to a thermal module shortage. This hits our eu-west-1 Dedicated top-up for next-week rollout.
Liam (Infra): Ugh. Do they offer a split/air option for the priority units?
NexaSupply Ops: Sorry — confirmed. We can split 30 units on air freight (ETA 72h) at +$700/unit or hold full container (ETA +10 days) at no extra fee. Customs QA noted a batch paperwork mismatch causing the holdup.
Maria G.: 30 units air would cover the canary + urgent customer commits. Cost is steep but acceptable if it avoids SLA misses. Need PO approval and AWB.
Ryan: What's the lead time on getting RMA labels for the DOA lane if any of the air units fail on receipt? We want a fast return path to avoid downtime.
NexaSupply Ops: We can pre-issue RMA labels and expedited return AWBs. We'll need serial ranges list and a signed RMA SLA addendum. I'll attach the label template and AWB terms.
Anika: @Maria G. can you confirm we have budget for the +$21k uplift? Also, logistics team — can you accept partial-split arrivals (30 units) into our FRA crossdock?
Maria G.: Budget check: yes for short-term uplift — product ops already green-lighted contingency.
NexaSupply Ops: Sending docs: https://files.nexasupply.example/h100-air-offer-1742103333.pdf (contains AWB sample, cost table, and RMA SLA).
logistics-bot: Reminder: FRA crossdock can handle incoming small batches M-F 06:00-18:00; out-of-window fees apply.
Liam (Infra): Two operational asks: 1) can we accept mixed-serial manifests into the staging cluster without triggering automated parity checks? 2) if we take air, we want pre-staged config images on the crossdock to reduce provisioning time.
Anika: Logistics confirms they can do pre-staging for up to 24 units per pallet if we provide config images S3 link and whitelist UID ranges.
Maria G.: I'll sign the PO for 30 units air. @NexaSupply Ops please pre-issue RMA labels and AWB, and set customs broker contact to "Redwood Customs" with our EORI.
NexaSupply Ops: Will do. RMA template: ``RMA-EXPEDITE-RED-2026``. AWB ETA 72h if docs clear.
Ryan: For provisioning: add a holdback of 2 units as bench spares and 1 reserved for immediate QA swap. Document in the manifest.
Liam (Infra): Add to rollout plan: canary uses 8 GPUs, then 10% traffic ramp. If any failures, auto-fallback to hosted model for affected routes.
Anika: I'll coordinate FRA arrival window and update the ticket with inbound AWB and RMA numbers once NexaSupply sends them.
Maria G.: Thanks — sequence: 1) PO signed, 2) NexaSupply sends AWB + pre-issued RMA, 3) FRA crossdock confirms arrival window + pre-staging, 4) infra pulls images and starts canary.
NexaSupply Ops: AWB #NEX-GBR-456789 issued, RMA batch id RMA-RED-2026-1742 pre-created. Docs emailed to procurement@redwood.example.
logistics-bot: Note: if customs requires HS reclassification, expect +24–48h and potential duty hold. Keep the backup sea option open.
Maria G.: Noted. If customs hold occurs we switch to the +10 day container and request credit for air uplift per SLA.
Ryan: One last ask — include thermal module part numbers on the manifest so our depot can validate heat-sink compatibility on receipt.
NexaSupply Ops: Will append thermal module PN TM-H100-3A to the packing list.
Maria G.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket with final AWB and PO number when processed. :thumbsup:
